description: Ministry of Home Affairs - Order to de clare that the Full Moon Poya Days for the year 2018
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notification declaring Full Moon Poya Days for 2018 under the authority of the Holidays Act, No. 29 of 1971. It represents a statutory instrument made under existing legislation, which falls squarely within the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the legal declaration being made, and there are no detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would trigger a government-related classification.
